frozen_requirement: one persistent PHASE ledger shared by worker/reviewer/repair/verify/failure, reserved before forward
root_cause: backend/lightgravity/api/bootstrap.py:build_runtime calls configure_generation_ledger(settings.data_dir) unconditionally, which sets _GLOBAL_GENERATION_COUNTER to a ledger rooted at settings.data_dir and thus overrides the LIGHTGRAVITY_GENERATION_LEDGER_DIR env override the driver set. Each attempt therefore gets its own per-attempt ledger instead of the single phase ledger.
minimal_repro: LIGHTGRAVITY_GENERATION_LEDGER_DIR=<phase> LIGHTGRAVITY_DATA_DIR=<phase> build_runtime(StartupOptions(settings=Settings(data_dir=<attempt>))); global_generation_counter().snapshot() roots the ledger at <attempt>/generation, not <phase>/generation.
why_no_fix_and_rerun: PM/owner stop rule: any sampling-time harness/measurement defect stops the whole cohort and preserves the partial. No fix-and-rerun of the same attempt; remaining budget is not permission to repeat the attempt.
